detailed_description: The HTML Table Generator creates a basic HTML table from an editable grid. Choose the number of rows and columns, decide whether the first row should be a header, fill in each cell, and review both the generated HTML and a simple table preview. The tool outputs plain table markup with thead and tbody when headers are enabled, and you can copy the generated HTML to the clipboard.
usage_steps: Set the row and column counts with the number inputs.
Enable or disable the header-row checkbox.
Enter text into each cell in the editable grid.
Review the generated HTML and the table preview.
Copy the HTML markup to use it elsewhere.
usage_examples: Create a small static comparison table for documentation.
Draft a simple product or feature matrix before styling it in your own CSS.
Generate starter table markup with a header row and body rows.
Copy plain HTML table code for a prototype or content page.

faqs.question: How do I create a table with a header row?
faqs.answer: Keep the 'Header row' checkbox enabled. The tool will output a <thead> element with <th> cells for the first row, and <tbody> with <td> cells for the remaining rows.

faqs.question: Can I dynamically add or remove rows and columns?
faqs.answer: Yes. Adjust the row and column number inputs to resize the grid; existing cell data is preserved when expanding.

faqs.question: Is the generated HTML ready to use in any project?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool outputs clean, semantic HTML markup without inline styles, making it easy to drop into markdown files, CMS editors, or custom stylesheets.
